'''Kjell Henriksen''' (1 February 1938 &ndash; 3 April 1996<ref>{{Cite web |title=Kjell Gunnar Henriksen |url=https://www.slektogdata.no/gravminner/grav/7f67f6a7-e499-4111-bc5b-200233d15710 |access-date=2024-08-04 |website=Slekt og Data |language=no}}</ref>) was a Norwegian scientist, professor at the [[University of Tromsø]] and researcher with a special interest in the [[aurora|polar lights]]. For his effort in researching the polar lights a new observatory has been named after him, the Kjell Henriksen Observatory on [[Svalbard]].
